findings.detail: Strict post-Order wording of _candidate_after_order docstring is not a universal exact chronology predicate. Source uses clamped main index and anchor lower bound; detailed S24 already qualifies.
Type3 and Type4 direct lower index access has no local null-index fallback; ordinary decision fallback only empty lower rows. Type4 requires public Blue while ordinary Reset map may include internal.
Same lower position versus same main candle race distinct; main race rejects both raw predicates before qualifier, even unqualified candidate. Existing S37 documents this distinction.
Order-free Type3/4 both evaluated; later shared accepted stop can attach Order provenance without changing original formation type. Distinguish formation, creation and later consumption.
